purpose: Identify one layer-resolved direct-absolute compiler that preserves the static prior and conditionally integrates process evidence while visible Program and privileged q_pi coordinates remain frozen.

information_wall.shared_gradient_tasks: fit19 development tasks update the shared compiler only
information_wall.held5: privileged transform and frozen inference only; zero shared gradient and zero code fitting
compiler_training_inputs: exact language and action-hidden correct-video event anchors
full successful-occupancy eight-phase source-subtracted action response
successful and learner occupancy full-layer source/expert owner responses
detached source target inputs and successful-member target-local LoRA activation effects
one fixed privileged q_pi Program coordinate per fit task captured from correct action-hidden videos
cross-episode successful train action chunks used only to identify the shared compiler
verified-success learner action chunks used only as a secondary compiler state-support stratum
stable-shared responses on the same panels as the prior-only compiler target
source, stable-shared and learner-policy counterfactual responses

fixed_program_coordinate.scope: fit19 privileged q_pi coordinates captured once and frozen for compiler-only identification

model.prior_only_surface: direct absolute complete rank16 LoRA from the same family-specific A/B heads used by full Programs
model.full_process_surface: direct absolute complete rank16 LoRA from the same family-specific A/B heads used by prior-only Programs
model.absolute_factor_heads: 38 target-local layer-resolved A/B heads preserve content-conditioned amplitude and write every target and rank directly; family determines shape and initialization only
model.q_pi_gate: member x event x owner content gate, bounded by visible event presence
model.program_content: owner/layer/family are tensor addresses; no additive address embeddings in visible Program values or q_pi factor values
model.compiler_content_path: language and scene form one local static read; ordered process and uncertainty form one presence-masked local process read; owner/layer/family addresses and numeric rank queries control both reads
model.query_content_modulation: numeric target/rank query multiplicatively modulates Program Values after static/process content interaction; it cannot output without Program content
model.static_process_fusion: static and process reads interact per target/rank before one shared nonlinear trunk; process is exactly zero when absent and no A/B-space adapter addition occurs
model.prior_head_calibration: fit19 frozen prior hidden makes a minimum-change target-local ridge correction to the stable shared rank16 authority before the fresh optimizer; no task table is retained
model.factor_head_init_basis: 0.4 times family A/B weight std implied by the 47 gauge-canonical successful-member RMS values; raw head amplitude is retained

data.video_sampling: without replacement deterministic per task visit
data.phase_source: fit19-frozen 350-to-32 whitening of complete 50x7 successful trajectory responses
data.learner_states: 30 frozen fit19 projected-policy trajectories; verified successes full weight and failures member-agreement/outcome weighted

policy_support.horizon_compression: orthonormal DCT low-frequency basis over complete 50-token owner projection and detached target inputs

objective.effective_update: diagnostic-only exact BA distance; zero optimization weight for full Programs
objective.canonical_factor_warmstart: diagnostic-only compact rank16 SVD gauge distance; zero optimization weight
objective.functional_response: paired complete PI0.5 final-flow plus target-local LoRA activation effects retained as bounded structural anchors
objective.action_grounding: exact PI0.5 flow-matching loss differentiated through the generated complete LoRA into the shared compiler only
objective.action_supervision: every fit task receives the same successful-panel base stratum; verified-success learner panels add state support; failed learner actions never produce gradients
objective.target_local_activation_effect: candidate and successful members apply each target B(Ax_ref) to the same detached source input in 38-owner x 4-horizon-basis policy-native output spaces
objective.prior_counterfactual: zero-process and full-process Programs both use the same attention, trunk and direct A/B heads; no exact-template branch
objective.prior_shared_response: prior-only compiler output matches stable-shared PI0.5 responses on every sampled functional panel
objective.prior_shared_response_scale: single-task profile calibrated so the prior path anchors rather than overwhelming the full action/functional compiler gradient

optimization.task_balance_contract: The 114-visit node contains exactly six visits for every fit task; rows remain cost-balanced within the block.
optimization.distributed: manual flat gradient mean, deferred NCCL, task-equal

materialization.sampling: fixed correct action-hidden videos without replacement
materialization.output: one frozen-q_pi consensus rank16 LoRA and one learned prior-only rank16 LoRA per task from the same layer-resolved compiler

gate2.failure_action: stop before q_V; repair the earliest q_pi/compiler/support interface instead of tuning rank, seed, dtype, or tiny LR sweeps
